meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: 网页与数字界面设计师在构建Web页面或应用组件时，若受够了千篇一律的AI味设计，请用此技能。一键生成极具视觉冲击力、排版独特、动效惊艳的生产级前端代码，告别平庸，打造令人难忘的高品质数字界面。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成排版独特、动效惊艳的生产级前端代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果受够了千篇一律的AI味网页设计
copy.tagline_en: Generate production-grade frontend code with unique typography and stunning motion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are tired of generic AI-look web designs

howto.what: 构建前端界面时，Claude 会先选定一个鲜明的美学方向（极简、复古未来、杂志排版等），再产出可运行的生产级代码（HTML/CSS/JS、React、Vue），并在字体、配色、动效和版式上逐项落实设计。
howto.when: 当你要求构建网页、组件、应用或界面时触发；原文针对的是受够千篇一律 AI 风格设计、想要有辨识度界面的场景。

say.text: 帮我做一个作品集落地页，走复古未来风
say.note: 它会先定美学方向再写代码

say.text: 把这个 React 组件重做，别用默认字体和紫色渐变
say.note: 会替换字体、配色与版式

say.text: 给这个页面加一段错落出现的入场动效
say.note: 用 animation-delay 编排加载动画

howto.what_en: For frontend work, Claude first commits to a bold aesthetic direction (minimal, retro-futuristic, editorial, etc.), then writes working production-grade code (HTML/CSS/JS, React, Vue) with deliberate typography, color, motion and layout choices.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to build a web page, component, app or interface, especially when you want a distinctive look instead of generic AI-generated design.

say_en.text: Build me a portfolio landing page with a retro-futuristic look
say_en.note: It picks an aesthetic direction first

say_en.text: Redo this React component without default fonts or purple gradients
say_en.note: Fonts, palette and layout get replaced

say_en.text: Add a staggered entrance animation to this page
say_en.note: Uses animation-delay for the load reveal
